response.sql: WITH purpose_averages AS (SELECT k_symbol, AVG(amount) AS average_amount FROM "order" WHERE amount > 2802 GROUP BY k_symbol), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(average_amount) AS average_amount FROM purpose_averages) SELECT p.k_symbol, p.average_amount, p.average_amount - o.average_amount AS amount_above_overall FROM purpose_averages AS p CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o WHERE p.average_amount > o.average_amount ORDER BY p.average_amount DESC
